CREATE TABLE "public"."park_facilities" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "description_en" text,
  "external_url" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_published" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric(9,6) NOT NULL,
  "longitude" numeric(9,6) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "name_en" character varying(150),
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "park_facilities_latitude_range_9dd11892" CHECK (latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90),
  CONSTRAINT "park_facilities_longitude_range_5fbf98d2" CHECK (longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180),
  CONSTRAINT "park_facilities_type_check_fd738207" CHECK ("type" IN ('TOILET', 'PARKING'))
)
